claims.text: Many reviewers report the cream effectively stops itching and helps heal rashes, eczema, and other skin irritation.
Reviewers frequently say it speeds healing of burns, sores, scars, and damaged skin, sometimes comparing it to prescription silver creams.
Several customers praise it as an excellent daily face moisturizer and after-shave cream that improves skin health.
One reviewer was disappointed that the ingredients were changed between purchases.
